sale_order.description: 销售订单主表；一行代表一张报价单或销售订单。

sale_order_line.description: 销售订单明细；分析产品、数量、交付和开票时使用，排除 display_type 非空的展示行。

res_partner.description: 客户和联系人；销售客户通常通过 sale_order.partner_id 关联。

product_product.description: 产品规格；通过 product_tmpl_id 连接产品模板。

product_template.description: 产品模板；name 是 JSONB 翻译字段，中文名称优先取 name->>'zh_CN'，再取 en_US。

res_users.description: Odoo 用户；销售员名称需通过 partner_id 连接 res_partner，不开放登录和密码字段。

res_company.description: 公司；所有事实查询必须限制为配置的 company_id。

uom_uom.description: 计量单位；name 是 JSONB 翻译字段。

sales_amount.name: 销售额
sales_amount.description: 已确认销售订单的未税金额。

tax_included_sales.name: 含税销售额
tax_included_sales.description: 已确认销售订单的含税总额。

sales_quantity.name: 销售数量
sales_quantity.description: 已确认订单非展示明细的订购数量。

delivered_quantity.name: 已交付数量
delivered_quantity.description: 已确认订单非展示明细的已交付数量。

invoiced_quantity.name: 已开票数量
invoiced_quantity.description: 已确认订单非展示明细的已开票数量。

examples.question: 本月销售额是多少？
examples.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(so.amount_untaxed), 0) AS sales_amount FROM sale_order AS so WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND so.date_order >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND so.date_order < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month'

examples.question: 销售额最高的十个客户是谁？
examples.sql: SELECT rp.name AS customer, SUM(so.amount_untaxed) AS sales_amount FROM sale_order AS so JOIN res_partner AS rp ON rp.id = so.partner_id WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') GROUP BY rp.id, rp.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 10

examples.question: 今年每个月销售趋势怎么样？
examples.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', so.date_order)::date AS month, SUM(so.amount_untaxed) AS sales_amount FROM sale_order AS so WHERE so.company_id = {company_id} AND so.state IN ('sale', 'done') AND so.date_order >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
